animation.finger_policy: Authored finger FK during free-hand phases; existing contact solver during grip.
animation.root_policy: In-place horizontal root, display-only authored vertical hip shift; cadence follows source root travel and actual motor speed.
animation.event_policy: Original real fire/damage signals; original ammo, timing and dash rules. Visual shot compressed to .28sec, hit to .55sec. Evade samples early .2sec during original .16sec dash then upper-body recovery.
animation.holster_policy: V local-only. Source socket timings interpreted as visual visibility, not executed Unity callbacks. Put hides at .49282077s; take shows at .086127274s. Original Quaternius arm recovery avoids transition T-pose. No back-mounted gun model or gameplay penalty.

preservation.actual_project_exceptions: isolated app name plus exactly two installation hooks

diagnostics.controlled01_02: Review script type-inference and nonexistent cancel_reload calls; rejected logs preserved.
diagnostics.native_review01: All contact/length checks passed but manual sprint showed receiver cutting face and holstered endpoint stuck at transition T-pose. Rejected as presentation candidate.
diagnostics.controlled04: New relax variable lacked type; rejected compile log preserved.
diagnostics.controlled06: Pose inspection outside modifier callback read restored FK rather than rendered arm pose. Assertions moved into modifier-processed measurements, same .25m drop threshold.
diagnostics.actual03_diagnostic: 1.07m maximum fitting traced to uninitialized newly mounted gun at model origin, not ongoing movement. Solver now waits for first valid controller pose.
diagnostics.final01: Cold import only before last startup guard. Never installed, native-tested or delivered.
diagnostics.final02: All 10 structural/input cases passed, but full-speed holstered movement still selected an accelerated WalkRelaxed clip. Superseded by final03: source Run lower-body at full speed, plus controlled and normal-input checks.

previews.processing: Resize/quantize/encode real engine PNGs; repeated boundary frames only. Controlled source poses, NOT battle footage or synthesized evidence.

limitations: This is local source integration, not a new EXE/PCK or production/default replacement.
AR-556 plus normal first sortie checked; all weapons, melee, cloth intersections, aiming cover interactions and full checkpoint/death/rapid-switch matrix are not certified.
Controlled free-hand phases intentionally do not assert weapon contact. Bone rest and lengths remain checked. Foot cadence/height is not all-frame sole planting.
Synthetic input/viewport clicking with visible-enemy aim, not physical gamepad or human first-hour acceptance.
The full previous 174 native-inclusive matrix was not rerun. Current default headless suite 149 categories plus local 10-case motion suite have separate scopes.
Five-hour content, maintenance zone/finale, more physical character scenes, audio/minimum hardware, rights and real player reviews remain work.
No commit, push, upload, author messaging or original heroine replacement.
